population_policy.rule: The expected population is this file's workload ids. A process is complete only when its RESULT and ALLOC lines match the exact id set, once each. A count of lines is not a completeness test.
population_policy.dropping_a_workload: not permitted after execution; a failed workload makes the campaign BLOCKED
population_policy.synthetic_and_real_rows: synthetic DH rows remain, labelled as synthetic; real FFDHE/MODP rows are separate ids and are never merged with them

operand_provenance.notes: The nonce is generated by the library and therefore differs between signatures; signatures are not compared byte-for-byte. Cross-verification at six repetitions signs with one subject and verifies with the other in both directions.
